verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client. Subnet routing to reach remote devices as if on their local network is a VPN/network-connectivity capability, outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such networking: the WebDAV server and External URL preview are file-sharing and preview features, not subnet routers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use subnet routers to reach devices outside my local network as if I were on it
